episodes.name: #SweetJustice (1)
episodes.overviewEn: When six ordinary girls meet and discover that they each have extraordinary powers, they decide to join forces to take on one of Metropolis's most sinister villains.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما تتأقلم "باتغيرل" مع أجواء مدرسة جديدة، تقابل خمس فتيات عاديات أخريات يمتلكن قوًى خارقة، ويوافقن على الاتحاد ضدّ أشرار "متروبوليس".

episodes.name: #SweetJustice (2)
episodes.overviewEn: When six ordinary girls meet and discover that they each have extraordinary powers, they decide to join forces to take on one of Metropolis's most sinister villains.
episodes.overviewAr: تدرب "وندر ومان" "سوبر غيرل" و"بامبلبي" و"باتغيرل" و"زاتانا" و"غرين لانترن" ليصبحن بطلات خارقات منقذات، فيما يعلّمنها كيف تكون مراهقة عادية.

episodes.name: #SweetJustice (3)
episodes.overviewEn: When six ordinary girls meet and discover that they each have extraordinary powers, they decide to join forces to take on one of Metropolis's most sinister villains.
episodes.overviewAr: حين يهدّد آليّو "ليكس كورب" بهدم متجر "سويت جاستس"، تقاتل الفتيات من أجل إنقاذه، فيما تتلقّى مراهقة خارقة عاصية عقابًا مفاجئًا.

episodes.name: #SweetJustice (4)
episodes.overviewEn: When six ordinary girls meet and discover that they each have extraordinary powers, they decide to join forces to take on one of Metropolis's most sinister villains.
episodes.overviewAr: تخطّط الفرقة الخارقة لمنع "ديانا" من العودة إلى موطنها. وفي "متروبوليس"، تندلع حرب بين آليّي "ليكس كورب" وفريق البطلات المؤسَّس حديثًا.

episodes.name: #AdventuresInBunnysitting
episodes.overviewEn: Zee asks Kara to look after her two magical bunnies, which quickly start to multiply to unmanageable numbers, wreaking havoc all across Metropolis.
episodes.overviewAr: بعدما تضعها "زاتانا" في موقع المسؤولية، تتلقّى "سوبر غيرل" درسًا في تحمّل المسؤولية بفضل أرنبين سحريّين يعيثان فسادًا في "متروبوليس".

episodes.name: #HateTriangle
episodes.overviewEn: Hal's ex-girlfriend Star Sapphire shows up at a Metropolis High football game and attacks him. Jessica tries to control the situation with nonviolent tactics. The episode was released on cable Video On Demand on March 17, 2019.
episodes.overviewAr: حين يثير الحبّ جنون الشريرة الخارقة "ستار سافاير" في حفل مباراة العودة، تتعرّض أساليب "غرين لانترن" السلميّة في القتال لاختبار حقيقي.

episodes.name: #BurritoBucket
episodes.overviewEn: Babs is at her job at the Burrito Bucket fast food restaurant. A bank robbery breaks out across the street, and Babs tries to thwart the bank robbery while following the instructions of her boss Shane O'Shaughnessy. The episode was released on cable Video On Demand on March 24, 2017.
episodes.overviewAr: تحاول "باتغيرل" الموازنة بين التزامها بمكافحة الجريمة وتقديم "البوريتو" حين تقع عملية سطو مسلّح على أحد البنوك أثناء أدائها لعملها.

episodes.name: #MeetTheCheetah
episodes.overviewEn: Barbi is envious of Diana who keeps upstaging her. She uses a cheetah statuette from her dad's collection to place a curse on Diana.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تحظى "وندر ومان" بمكانة تاقت إلى بلوغها دومًا في فريق الجمباز، تُلقي زميلة غيورة تعويذة من غابر الأزمان تغيّر الشخصية، فماذا سيحدث؟

episodes.name: #Beeline
episodes.overviewEn: Karen stumbles across a villainous plot led by Harley Quinn to blow up a bridge.
episodes.overviewAr: تتّحد "بامبلبي" الشجاعة والفريق لردع مخطّط شرير حاكته "هارلي كوين" و"ستار سافاير" و"كاتوومان" و"لايفواير" و"بويزن آيفي" و"جايغانتا".

episodes.name: #SuperWho?
episodes.overviewEn: Kara deals with not getting her equal share of the credit for rescuing the people of Metropolis, while her cousin Superman gets all the credit.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تنزعج "سوبر غيرل" من "سوبر مان" لخطف الأضواء عن أعمالهنّ البطولية، تبذل ما في وسعها للتفوّق على ذلك المنافس الباحث عن المجد.

episodes.name: #ShockItToMe
episodes.overviewEn: Leslie Willis gains popularity on the website MetropoVids by posting mean-spirited videos, causing Wonder Woman to question the moral integrity of the people who live in the World of Man.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تشتهر طالبة ثانوية لئيمة لنشرها مقاطع فيديو قاسية لزملائها بهدف إحراجهم، تتساءل "وندر ومان" عن أخلاقيات سكان "متروبوليس".

episodes.name: #SheMightBeGiant
episodes.overviewEn: Karen tries to upgrade her Bumblebee suit so it makes her giant-sized instead of bug-sized. Giganta beats all the other Super Hero Girls and it's up to Bumblebee to stop her. The episode directly follows the first four according to a Twitter post by executive producer Lauren Faust.
episodes.overviewAr: رغم تعرّضها للتنمّر في المدرسة، تتحرّك "بامبلبي" بحجمها الضئيل لكبح جماح غضب شريرة خارقة عملاقة تشنّ هجومًا على مركز تجاري في المدينة.

episodes.name: #FightAtTheMuseum
episodes.overviewEn: Supergirl attempts to foil a burglary perpetrated by Catwoman.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تتسلّل "كاتوومان" إلى متحف العلوم في المدينة لسرقة أحجار كريمة، تضطر "سوبر غيرل" إلى الاعتماد على عقلها وليس عضلاتها للتغلّب عليها.

episodes.name: #FromBatToWorse
episodes.overviewEn: Babs tells her friends how she wanted to be Batman's sidekick before moving from Gotham to Metropolis. Batman calls her father, Commissioner Gordon, alerting him about a Gotham villain coming to Metropolis. Babs sees this as her chance to impress Batman and join the Bat-team. The episode was released online on July 19, 2019 on the Cartoon Network website.
episodes.overviewAr: حين يطلب حامي مدينة "غوثام" الأكثر شعبية مساعدة من "باتغيرل"، يتحتّم عليها أولًا إيجاد طريقة لإخفاء الأمر عن والدها، المفوّض "جيم غوردون".

episodes.name: #CrushingIt
episodes.overviewEn: Diana Prince is admired by her friends and schoolmates at Metropolis High, until Steve Trevor shows up and makes her love-struck. The episode was released online on July 19, 2019 on the Cartoon Network website.
episodes.overviewAr: خلال أسبوع مُثقل بالأحداث والأعمال الموكلة إليها، يتشتّت انتباه "وندر ومان" مع ظهور فتًى وسيم جديد مهدّدًا أداءها... فهل تعود إلى طبيعتها؟

episodes.name: #MisgivingTree
episodes.overviewEn: Jessica Cruz and Pam Isley bond over protecting an ancient tree from being cut down. When the workmen arrive to cut the tree, Pam attacks them as Poison Ivy while Jessica protects them as Green Lantern. The episode was released online on July 19, 2019 on the Cartoon Network website.
episodes.overviewAr: رغم عدم دراية أيّ منهما بالشخصية التي تتقمّصها الأخرى، تتّحد جهود "غرين لانترن" و"بويزن آيفي" لإنقاذ شجرة عتيقة من القطع الجائر.

episodes.name: #IllusionsOfGrandeur
episodes.overviewEn: Zee tries to win over crowds at the Metropolis pier with her magic. The episode was released online on July 26, 2019 on the Cartoon Network website.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد انصراف الحضور عن مشاهدة الخدع السحرية المزيّفة التي تقدمها، تُطلق "زاتانا" الغاضبة دون قصد منها مخلوقات شريرة تتسبّب في ترويع المرفأ.

episodes.name: #BeastsInShow
episodes.overviewEn: Babs and Kara enter their respective dogs Ace and Krypto into a dog show. The episode was released online on July 26, 2019 on the Cartoon Network website.
episodes.overviewAr: تحسِم "باتغيرل" و"سوبر غيرل" الرهان خلال مسابقة محتدِمة بين الكلاب، حيث يتدخل كلباهما المتألِّقان لإنقاذ موقف ما... فما هو؟

episodes.name: #GothamCon
episodes.overviewEn: Babs and Harley go to the GothamCon convention where Babs hopes to meet Batman but meets Robin instead. The episode premiered July 19, 2019 at the San Diego Comic Con. The episode was released online on July 26, 2019 on the Cartoon Network website.
episodes.overviewAr: تُثار مشاكل في المؤتمر السنوي للمتحمّسين في مدينة "غوثام"، حيث تواجه كلّ من "باربرا غوردون" وصديقتها "هارلين كوينزل" الشخصية الخارقة للأخرى.

episodes.name: #DCSuperHeroBoys (1)
episodes.overviewEn: The Super Hero Girls investigate what they believe to be spray-tag vandalism when they encounter a rival superhero team, the Super Hero Boys. Together, both teams fight off an invasion of three Kryptonians bent on world domination. The episode was released on September 2, 2019 on online streaming services.
episodes.overviewAr: أثناء التحقيق في عملية تخريب، تجد الفرقة الخارقة ثلاثة أقوياء منتمين لفصيلة كربتونية ومتعطّشين للهيمنة على العالم. ترقبوا الإثارة والتشويق!

episodes.name: #DCSuperHeroBoys (2)
episodes.overviewEn: The Super Hero Girls investigate what they believe to be spray-tag vandalism when they encounter a rival superhero team, the Super Hero Boys. Together, both teams fight off an invasion of three Kryptonians bent on world domination.
episodes.overviewAr: تواجه المراهقات الخارقات، "وندر ومان" و"سوبر غيرل" و"بامبلبي" و"باتغيرل" و"زاتانا" و"غرين لانترن"، منافسيهم من "الأبطال الخارقين الفتيان".

episodes.name: #Frenemies (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Harleen Quinzel, Babs's best friend, moves from Gotham to Metropolis. Harleen is disliked by Babs's new friends, and Babs doesn't get along with Harleen's new friends.
episodes.overviewAr: تضيق البطلات ذرعًا من مقالب "هارلين"، فتتقمّص هذه الأخيرة شخصية بديلة وتشرع في تخريب "متروبوليس" بمساعدة طاقم شرير جديد.

episodes.name: #Frenemies (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Harleen Quinzel, Babs's best friend, moves from Gotham to Metropolis. Harleen is disliked by Babs's new friends, and Babs doesn't get along with Harleen's new friends.
episodes.overviewAr: تحاول "باربرا" استعادة صداقتها بـ"هارلين"، فيما تواجه "هارلي" و"كاتوومان" و"بويزن آيفي" و"ستار سافاير" و"جايغانتا" و"لايفواير" البطلات.

episodes.name: #SoulSisters (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Diana meets Tatsu and faces off against the vigilante Katana who traps the souls of people in her sword.
episodes.overviewAr: تتوطد علاقة "ديانا" بزميلتها المبارزة "تاتسو"، بينما تتعقب "سوبر غيرل" و"بامبلبي" و"باتغيرل" و"زاتانا" و"غرين لانترن" ساموراي تحصد الأرواح.

episodes.name: #SoulSisters (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Diana meets Tatsu and faces off against the vigilante Katana who traps the souls of people in her sword.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما تتدخل الفتيات في مهمة "كاتانا" الرامية إلى معاقبة الأشرار، تساعد "ديانا" صديقتها الجديدة كي تصبح بطلة حقيقية.

episodes.name: #Abracadabrapalooza
episodes.overviewEn: Zee recounts to Karen her embarassing transition into magichood and her relationship with her father at that time. The episode was released on November 25, 2019, on online streaming services.
episodes.overviewAr: تهلع "بامبلبي" عند رؤيتها عيبًا في وجهها، وتعلِّمها "زي" فن المكياج المسرحي.

episodes.name: #RageCat
episodes.overviewEn: Jessica tries to find an adoptive home for the cat Dexter, who turns into a member of the Red Lantern corps and attacks her. The episode was released on November 26, 2019, on online streaming services.
episodes.overviewAr: تحاول "جيسيكا" إيجاد منزل مثالي للقطّ "ديكستر" الساخط الذي كان يعيش في ملجأ الحيوانات ولديه خططه الخاصّة بشأن المستقبل.

episodes.name: #TheGoodTheBadAndTheBizarre
episodes.overviewEn: Everything is going well for Kara Danvers, both as a teen and a superhero, until she starts taking the blame for things she didn't do, and the emergence of a new supervillain threatens to destroy Supergirl's hard-earned reputation.
episodes.overviewAr: تسوء سمعة "كارا" كفتاة صالحة عندما يوجَّه إليها اللوم بشأن أفعال شائنة لا شأن لها بها، وإنما ترتكبها شرّيرة خارقة جديدة.

episodes.name: #BackInAFlash
episodes.overviewEn: Babs tells Flash he can travel back in time, and she travels in time with him to change various events in her past. The episode was released on November 28, 2019, on online streaming services.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد إطلاق ريح في اجتماع مدرسيّ، تستغلّ "باربرا" قدرات "فلاش" على السفر عبر الزمن لتجنّب الخزي الذي تتعرّض له بسبب هذا الحادث.

episodes.name: #PowerSurge
episodes.overviewEn: Supergirl is presumed dead by the media after a battle with Livewire. The episode was released on November 29, 2019, on online streaming services.
episodes.overviewAr: عندما يظنّ عامّة الناس أن "سوبر غيرل" قد لاقت حتفها بعد صراع مع "لايفواير"، تنتهز "كارا" الفرصة لتغيير شخصيتها البطولية.

episodes.name: #ScrambledEggs
episodes.overviewEn: The student alter-egos of the Super Hero Girls, Super Hero Boys, and super villain girls are given a home economics assignment of caring for an egg. The episode was released on Video-On-Demand on December 18, 2019.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تتطلّب مهمّة مدرسية من الفتيات الاعتناء ببيضة وإلّا الحرمان من إجازتهنّ الصيفية، تقاتل الفتيات للحفاظ على عطلتهنّ… وبكلّ معنى الكلمة.

episodes.name: #DramaQueen
episodes.overviewEn: Oliver Queen sabotages the audition of Mortimer Drake for a play written and directed by Zee, and later finds that Mortimer is out for revenge on Zee for upstaging him in a play years ago. The episode was released on Video-On-Demand on December 18, 2019.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما ينافس "أوليفر كوين" خصمه "مورتيمر دريك" من أجل دور مرغوب في مسرحية، يجد "السهم الأخضر" نفسه في صراع مع شرّير خارق جديد.

episodes.name: #AllyCat (1)
episodes.overviewEn: The girls recruit Catwoman to help them plan and execute a heist for the Book of Eternity which is in the posession of Lex Luthor. The episode parts are numbered 39 and 40 by Cartoon Network and released on video-on-demand on March 4, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: حين يكتشف "ليكس لوثور" كتابًا يحوي قوًى سحرية، تحوك الفتيات خطّة محفوفة بالمخاطر تتضمّن الاستعانة بمساعدة حليفة غير متوقّعة لاسترجاعه.

episodes.name: #AllyCat (2)
episodes.overviewEn: The girls recruit Catwoman to help them plan and execute a heist for the Book of Eternity which is in the posession of Lex Luthor. The episode parts are numbered 39 and 40 by Cartoon Network and released on video-on-demand on March 4, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: بعدما يكشف "ليكس لوثور" عن خطّته الشرّيرة لتدمير العالم، تغتنم "كاتوومان" فرصة لتغيير مسار الأحداث… فهل تنجح في ذلك؟

episodes.name: #Retreat
episodes.overviewEn: Jess takes Garth, Babs, Hal, Karen, and Pam to her parents' cabin retreat in the woods. The episode is numbered 31 in a Cartoon Network press release from March 4, 2020. The episode was released on video-on-demand services on March 4, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: أثناء رحلة تخييم ليلية، تهاجم "بويزون آيفي" والنباتات من الموتى الأحياء فريقَ الخارقات اللائي لا حول لهنّ ولا قوّة.

episodes.name: #DinnerForFive
episodes.overviewEn: Babs meets Rose who moved to Metropolis to spend more time with her father. The episode is numbered 45 in a Cartoon Network press release from March 4, 2020. The episode was released on the Cartoon Network website on March 6, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تدعو صديقة جديدة "باربرا" على العشاء، سرعان ما يتحوّل الأمر إلى صراع… فما السبب يا تُرى؟

episodes.name: #LivingTheNightmare
episodes.overviewEn: When Zee's friends are held captive in their nightmares by a dream demon, she'll have to confront her own hidden insecurities, or risk the Super Hero Girls being trapped in a prison of their own fears forever. The episode is numbered 32 in a Cartoon Network press release from March 4, 2020. The episode was released on the Cartoon Network website on March 27, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: يتعيّن على "زي" مواجهة مخاوفها لإنقاذ صديقاتها الخارقات بعدما يأسرهنّ شيطان الأحلام في كوابيسهنّ… فهل تنجح؟

episodes.name: #AllAboutZee
episodes.overviewEn: Zee Zatara is flattered when she meets an overeager admirer Casey Krinsky, but soon realizes that "her biggest fan" wants much more than just an autograph. The episode was released on the Cartoon Network website on March 27, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تفقد "زي" قواها الخارقة حين تصبح معجبة مهووسة بها شبيهةً لها تمامًا… فهل من شيء قد يغيّر مجرى الأحداث؟

episodes.name: #TweenTitans
episodes.overviewEn: Jessica Cruz is hired by billionaire playboy Bruce Wayne to chaperone young Dick Grayson's Metropolis birthday bash and brings Karen Beecher along to help, but the girls get more than they bargained for when the TWEEN party guests reveal their TITANic personalities. The episode was released on the Cartoon Network website on March 27, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تُشرِف "جيسيكا" و"كارين" على حفل عيد ميلاد "ديك غرايسون" في "متروبوليس"، ولكن يصعب عليهما التعامل مع ضيوفه المراهقين الصغار.

episodes.name: #EmperorPenguin
episodes.overviewEn: When Barbara Gordon attempts to do something nice for a friend, she ends up in the clutches of The Penguin, a high school mob boss who blackmails her into an increasingly desperate situation from which only Batgirl can save her. The episode was released on streaming services on April 16, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تُقدم "باربرا" على فعل الخير، فتتورّط في مخطّط زعيم عصابة في مدرستها الثانوية.

episodes.name: #BreakingNews
episodes.overviewEn: Lois Lane's attempt to get an internship at the Daily Planet leads to her trying to unmask the Super Hero Girls, which forces the girls to a battle of wits with their greatest nemesis yet. The episode was released on streaming services on April 16, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تحاول "لويس لين" اقتناص فرصة التدريب في صحيفة "دايلي بلانيت"، غير أنّ تكليفها بكشف هويّة الفتيات الخارقات يجبرهنّ على التصرّف بطرق مبتكرة.

episodes.name: #CrashCourse
episodes.overviewEn: When a high-speed chase breaks out during her driver’s test, Diana Prince’s desire to fight evil clashes with her desire to undergo a World of Man teenage rite of passage, getting her license. The episode was released on the Cartoon Network website on April 17, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تُقرّر "ديانا" أخيرًا الحصول على رخصة قيادة، لكنّ الاختبار لا يسير بالضبط وفقًا للخطّة.

episodes.name: #LeagueOfShadows (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Ra's Al Ghul uses red kryptonite to make Kara susceptible to mind control and use her on his mission to purify the world, starting with the music of Karen's favorite boy band, Up Past 8. The episodes are numbered 35 and 36 by Lauren Faust.
episodes.overviewAr: تصطحب "كارا" صديقتها "كارين" لحضور حفل لفرقتها المفضّلة، لكنّ الأمور تسوء حين يدعوهما عازف الغيتار الأساسي إلى الكواليس.

episodes.name: #LeagueOfShadows (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Ra's Al Ghul uses red kryptonite to make Kara susceptible to mind control and use her on his mission to purify the world, starting with the music of Karen's favorite boy band, Up Past 8. The episodes are numbered 35 and 36 by Lauren Faust.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد الحفل، تعود "كارين" إلى شخصيتها القديمة… لكنّ قدرة "رأس الغول" على التحكّم تجعل "كارا" تتصرّف على غير طبيعتها.

episodes.name: #HousePest
episodes.overviewEn: When the Super Hero Girls discover that Diana doesn't actually have a home, they gladly open theirs up to her… until they discover that life with an Amazon is much more challenging than they expected. The episode was released on the Cartoon Network website on April 17, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تدرك "الفتيات الخارقات" أنّ "ديانا" تعيش على شجرة فيفتحنَ بيوتهنّ لها… ولكن يتّضح أنّها رفيقة سكن صعبة.

episodes.name: #It'sComplicated
episodes.overviewEn: Carol gets a new boyfriend, and Hal tries to win her back. The episode was released on streaming services on September 9, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: يكتشف "هال" أنّ "كارول" لديها حبيب جديد، فيبذل مجهودًا مُضنيًا ليفسد العلاقة بينهما.

episodes.name: #TheBirdAndTheBee
episodes.overviewEn: Karen helps Carter reunite with his beloved. The episode was released on streaming services on September 18, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تعلم "كارين" بشأن مصير "كارتر" الرومانسي المأساوي، وتُقرّر مساعدته على استعادة حبّه الحقيقي.

episodes.name: #FantasticBeastsAndHowToMindThem
episodes.overviewEn: Diana Prince receives a care package from home, and her pet-raising skills are soon put to the test when a mysterious egg hatches. The episode was released on streaming services on September 18, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تُختَبر مهارات "ديانا" في الاعتناء حين تفقس بيضة غامضة من الديار وتصبح كائن غريفين صغيرًا.

episodes.name: #SchoolGhoul
episodes.overviewEn: Tatsu contacts Babs and Kara to help her find and exorcise a ghost that is haunting a boarding school. The episode was released on streaming services on September 18, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: تساعد "باربرا" و"كارا" صديقتهما "تاتسو" في تعقّب شبح يسكن في ممرّات أكاديمية "ماكدوغال" الصارمة.

episodes.name: #AwesomeAuntAntiope
episodes.overviewEn: Diana is visited by her aunt Antiope who arrives at Metropolis after being sent from Themyscira to change the locks on the cage of the Kraken. The episode is numbered 30 in a Twitter post by Lauren Faust.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تأتي "أنتايوبي" المشاغبة لأجل الزيارة وتصطحب "الفتيات الخارقات" ليخرجنَ في البلدة، ترى "ديانا" تصرّفات خالتها من منظور جديد ومختلف.

episodes.name: #TheFreshPrincessOfRenFaire (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Ember the dragon wants to eat Zee, mistaking her for a princess. The episodes were released on streaming services in New Zealand on September 21, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: يتّخذ يوم في مهرجان "النهضة" منعطفًا مظلمًا حين تضع امرأة تبيع قطع الدجاج وتحمل سرًّا عينيها على "زي".

episodes.name: #TheFreshPrincessOfRenFaire (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Ember the dragon wants to eat Zee, mistaking her for a princess. The episodes were released on streaming services in New Zealand on September 21, 2020.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تشنّ "إمبر" هجومًا قويًّا، يتعيّن على "ديانا" و"زي" وضع خلافاتهما جانبًا والاتّحاد معًا من أجل هزيمتها.

episodes.name: #AmBatgirl: (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Batgirl finally has the chance to live out her life's dream and be the sidekick to her hero and inspiration—the Batman!

episodes.name: #AmBatgirl: (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Batgirl finally has the chance to live out her life's dream and be the sidekick to her hero and inspiration - the Batman!

episodes.name: #DoubleDanvers
episodes.overviewEn: When Kara realizes that she needs to be in two places on the same night, a dinner with an important investor in her parents startup and a concert for her favorite band, she calls for reinforcements in the form of Bizarro Kara.

episodes.name: #AccordingtoGarth
episodes.overviewEn: Garth meets a friend who shares his obsession with a particular fandom, but when that friend takes his obsession too far, Garth must learn the difference between being a fan and being a fanatic, or risk driving his friends away.

episodes.name: #SuperWonderBatBeeZeeLanterMobile
episodes.overviewEn: The Super Hero Girls decide to go in together to buy their first car but quickly learned that splitting an automobile six ways may prove to be there deadliest foe yet.

episodes.name: #SirensConch
episodes.overviewEn: Diana is asked to sing in a talent show, but when she uses a magical artifact to hide how bad she is at singing, she unleashes mayhem onto Metropolis.

episodes.name: #AngerManagement
episodes.overviewEn: When Jess coerces Kara into addressing her anger management issues, Supergirl's superhero abilities become seriously compromised.

episodes.name: #HappyBirthdayZee
episodes.overviewEn: Zatanna makes a Birthday wish that it forces her to confront the dark side of her magic.

episodes.name: #TheGreenRoom
episodes.overviewEn: When Jessica is faced with a Green Lantern Corps disciplinary hearing, Hal appoints himself to be her Peer Advocate.

episodes.name: #EnterNightSting
episodes.overviewEn: Karen is given a mission to prevent the apocalypse by DeathSting, a super-cool future version of herself.

episodes.name: #WorldsFinest
episodes.overviewEn: When public relations whiz Max Lord tells Batgirl and Supergirl he can improve their image by doing publicity stunts, the two friends forget what being a hero is really about.

episodes.name: #WorkingStiff
episodes.overviewEn: After Babs hooks Karen up with a job at the Burrito Bucket the two heroes encounter a new villain, the scourge of the fast-food underworld, the Condiment King!

episodes.name: #MultipliciZee
episodes.overviewEn: Zee magically duplicates herself so she can shirk work and watch TV; things get out of hand when her copies start to make copies of themselves.

episodes.name: #TheMinus
episodes.overviewEn: Diana receives her first ever A minus and becomes convinced that she needs to work harder, however, in order to do so, she resorts to rather drastic measures.

episodes.name: #Powerless
episodes.overviewEn: Supergirl loses her powers and, with the help of BumbleBee, must rely on her street smarts to save Garth from vengeful Toyman.

episodes.name: #AcceptNoSubstitute
episodes.overviewEn: Feeling smothered, Babs urges her retired dad, Commissioner Gordon, to get a hobby, but her advice backfires when the commissioner becomes a substitute teacher at her school.

episodes.name: #WarriorandtheJester
episodes.overviewEn: After accidentally destroying one of Babs' beloved, one-of-a-kind Batman keepsakes, Diana Enlists the help of Harleen Quinzel in order to find a replacement in Gotham City.

episodes.name: #MotherKnowsBest
episodes.overviewEn: Hippolyta visits town, and Diana is desperate to win her approval; when Hippolyta unexpectedly takes a shine to Kara, Diana must curb her envy before they all get hurt.

episodes.name: #DetentionClub
episodes.overviewEn: Five socially disparate teens, Hal, Pam, Kara, Zee and Garth, find they have more in common than they thought after spending a Saturday in detention.

episodes.name: #SmallVictories
episodes.overviewEn: A malfunctioning device shrinks Karen into the Microverse, leaving technophobic Diana as her only hope.

episodes.name: #CruzControl
episodes.overviewEn: Working towards her dream of making her school a better place, Jessica runs for class president.

episodes.name: #WhySoBlue
episodes.overviewEn: Supergirl must rein in a reckless new hero, the Blue Beetle.

episodes.name: #OneEnchantedEvening
episodes.overviewEn: Zee worries that Zatara is lonely and volunteers to play matchmaker for her dad; when her meddlesome matchmaking accidentally sets her dad up with an old enemy.

episodes.name: #TheAquamanCometh
episodes.overviewEn: For months, Garth sends Aquaman letters that greatly exaggerate his accomplishments in Metropolis; when the King of Atlantis comes for a surprise visit, Garth begs the Super Hero Girls to help cover for his little white lies.

episodes.name: #NightmareInGotham (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Babs and Harleen bring the Girls to Gotham City to celebrate Halloween! However, the fun is put on hold when the Super Hero Girls run into Gotham's most notorious Super Villain.

episodes.name: #NightmareInGotham (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Babs and Harleen bring the Girls to Gotham City to celebrate Halloween! However, the fun is put on hold when the Super Hero Girls run into Gotham's most notorious Super Villain.
